description: Match the packages and versions in a lockfile against incidents that state fixed versions, and print a receipt: what you use, the version, affected or not, and the exact upgrade. Accepts package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Pipfile.lock, composer.lock, go.sum, go.mod, Cargo.lock, Gemfile.lock, a Dockerfile, an .nvmrc / .node-version ("node") or a GitHub Actions workflow ("actions"). For several files at once, use check_repo.

ecosystem.description: Which reader to use. "auto" detects from the content. "node" is an .nvmrc or .node-version file, "actions" a GitHub Actions workflow.

name: check_lockfile
title: Check a lockfile
